item.title: About the Package Maintainers category
item.author: straight-shoota
item.content:encoded: This is a dedicated space for maintainers of Crystal packages, to coordinate and collaborate between upstream and downstream projects, as well as between downstreams from different ecosystems. If you’re having trouble with a Crystal package, please reach out to the package maintainer’s support channel directly, or post in Help & Support - Crystal Forum.The topics here are publicly accessible and an Atom feed for new topics is available, as well as individual feeds for replies in each topic. Active participation requires a forum account. As a registered user you can also subscribe to email notifications.
